root_cause.text: The AppArmor `d_namespace_path` function fails to null-terminate the path buffer after appending a trailing slash to non-root directory paths, leading to an out-of-bounds read during subsequent string matching.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that when `!is_root` is true, the code writes a slash to `buf[aa_g_path_max - 2]` but lacks a null terminator at `buf[aa_g_path_max - 1]`, which is resolved by adding `buf[aa_g_path_max - 1] = '\0';`. This missing termination is what triggered the KASAN slab-out-of-bounds read in `aa_dfa_match`.
